title: Patching, Firewalls, Logs, and Mandatory Controls
objective: Layer preventative, detective, and containment controls.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Remove unused packages and automate supported updates with distribution-appropriate modules. Firewalls should expose only required services while preserving tested management access.
Rotate and centralize logs, monitor authentication failures, and block abusive sources. SELinux or AppArmor constrains processes even after ordinary permissions are bypassed.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Layer preventative, detective, and containment controls.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
defense_in_depth:
  updates: automated
  firewall: default_deny
  logs: retained_and_monitored
  mandatory_access_control: enabled
